limitations.note: Blocked and stale work, cycle time, time in status, aging, and created versus completed are listed as not yet available and cannot be placed; they join the same metric port when 5C defines them. The integrator reconciles the service chain, migration, and identifier ranges with 5C.

limitations.item: AI usage and cost, automation and agent rates, test and release metrics
limitations.note: RPT-012, RPT-013, and RPT-015 are foundations: listed as not yet available with their owner phase.
A release dashboard is a brand dashboard until releases exist.
The dependency-free PDF writer uses a base font: characters outside Latin letters become a question mark in the PDF (CSV keeps them).

A scheduled email carries the recipient's figures (bounded rows) and a link; attachments and in-email charts are not sent. Recipients are not notified when a report is shared with them (4B share notices are a later refinement).

limitations.item: Personal dashboards of a departed member
limitations.note: They stay unreadable to everyone and are removed with the workspace; they hold layout only.

limitations.item: Fiscal calendars and per-brand report zones
limitations.note: Ranges use the workspace calendar day and week start (DQ-41).
A guest or share-only reader opens only a report shared with them and sees guest-safe record counts over the records they hold; they have no dashboards, Home overview, or export.
